Summary

With over 23 years of experience in Fixed Income, Derivatives, and Market Risk, My last job was as a Senior Market Risk Analyst with FinSurge Pvt.Ltd, at Axis Bank site, where I was looking into issues faced by users in ERM and MLC modules of Murex application.

I have earlier worked as a Fixed Income SME, leveraging my expertise in pricing and valuation of fixed income instruments, equity and forex derivatives to provide reliable data and analysis, helping clients meet regulatory guidelines on valuation and risk management. I have knowledge of Market Risk terms as VaR, Expected Shortfall (ES), SVaR, Stress Testing, Backtesting, and Sensitivity Analysis
